scope: CVG-OPS bounded critical process runner timeout, signal, descendant-cleanup and failure-artifact contract

criteria.description: The current ten-entry process manifest and fresh PIX timeout are confirmed as a runner-evidence gap, without changing process business semantics or promoting global readiness.
criteria.limitations: The runner failure is local evidence only; target, provider, remote CI, production and release remain open.

criteria.description: The authorized surface is limited to runner code, contract tests, CI artifact/timeout wiring and documentation; no process fixture or product behavior is changed to evade the timeout.
criteria.limitations: A fresh run is required before any bounded runner PASS.

criteria.description: Finite timeout, typed failure classification, owned descendant termination, sanitized diagnostics and failure-artifact preservation are concrete testable acceptance criteria.
criteria.limitations: This gate authorizes implementation and testing only; it does not claim the criteria are implemented.

gaps: The runner has not yet been corrected or rerun; current 25/25 PIX and 10/10 manifest completion are acceptance targets, not evidence.
Remote CI, target operations, providers, production, parity, accessibility, backup/restore and release remain outside scope.
conditions: Keep timeout enforcement finite and preserve the full current manifest.
Preserve failure artifacts on any non-success and sanitize diagnostics before writing them.
Do not convert a locally complete runner into a global or release verdict.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation of the consolidation request and original consolidation brief
authority.scope: CVG-OPS bounded critical process runner timeout, signal, descendant-cleanup and failure-artifact contract
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository changes to the serial critical-process runner, its contract tests, CI timeout/artifact wiring and bounded documentation only; exclude product semantics, providers, target, production and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing process fixtures/business behavior, running target/production, using credentials or claiming full/global/release readiness.

next_action: Write and execute intentional RED tests, then implement the smallest runner reliability correction while retaining the ten-entry manifest and global promotion blockers.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to PROCESS_TESTS, process fixtures, Vitest JSON report semantics or timeout policy
Changes to CI job budget, artifact retention or process-group cleanup behavior
Expansion into target, provider, production, deployment, credential or release scope
